saw_lines: Scooter buyers compare range, load and hill climb, then hesitate over the price of a brand they have never ridden.
So sales are won or lost in line one, where a buyer decides if a new brand deserves a second look.
0 of 18 ads carry a proof number, so new buyers have no reason to trust it. Collect one real figure, like review count or orders shipped, and lead with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 19 Oct 2026
points: 0 of 18 ads carry a proof number, so a new buyer has no reason to trust a scooter this costly. Collect one real figure, like your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.
7 of 18 copy ads open on the same VX4 SUV line, so scrollers meet one pitch and stop reading. Write two new openers, one on the 150 kg load and one on range, and run them beside that line.
Your site promotes free shipping from CHF 100, yet 0 of 18 ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to act. Put the shipping offer in the first line of three new ads for first time buyers.

30 ads have run 60 days or more, so the account has winners to build from. Build three variations of the oldest winner, each with a new first line and a different camera angle, and keep the same spec copy.
